messages:
Nora (PM): Quick thread to finalize Private deploy scope: packaging format, upgrade handoff (customer-managed networks), and rollback guarantees. Need owners and freeze date.
Diego (Eng): For MVP we should avoid full orchestration. Recommend 'handshake' where customer authorizes a specific window; Redwood runs upgrade only after confirmation.
Priya (Field Eng): Field asks: preserve peering IPs when possible, option to opt-out of auto-upgrades, and a short rollback SLAs doc.
Sam (NetOps): Technical constraints: IP preservation depends on host networking and BGP. For cloud-managed VMs we can signal but not guarantee. Propose manifest flag `network.preserve_ips=true|false` and explicit consent.
Nora (PM): Decision proposal: MVP = handshake protocol + snapshot-based rollback + operator-assist scripts. Defer managed auto-upgrade until later.
Ally (CS): CS will draft a customer-facing rollback playbook and pre- and post-upgrade comm templates. Need a one-page summary for legal and procurement.
release-bot: release-bot: nightly-build-2025.02.11 44d smoke ok
Diego (Eng): Upgrade flow sketch: manifest validation -> preflight checks (disk, KMS, CIDR) -> KV+config snapshot -> optional drain -> run upgrade -> run health checks -> if fail, restore snapshot + revert manifest.
Priya (Field Eng): I'll recruit three pilots: Cartwheel, SummitHealth, BankOne. We'll test handshake windows and preserve_ips semantics.
Sam (NetOps): Handshake details: customer submits token + intended window + ASN/CIDR. System validates overlaps and returns an approval token with TTL. Will log approvals for audit.
Diego (Eng): CLI example: `redwood-upgrade --manifest=site.json --handshake-token=abc123 --preserve-ips`. Manifest will include `upgrade.handoff.mode` and `network.preserve_ips`.
Nora (PM): Owners and dates: CS/Field playbook draft by 2026-04-09, Eng implementation by 2026-04-16, Docs publish by 2026-04-22. Weekly sync until pilots complete.
Ally (CS): Noted. I'll start drafts and tag legal for the IP retention language.
Diego (Eng): Preflight checks to implement: handshake token presence, CIDR overlap tests, KMS key access, and available disk for snapshot.
Nora (PM): If no objections by EOD Wednesday we'll freeze MVP scope. Thanks all.
